subject: slate/collect.py & slate/data/ratings.csv:269 & slate/data/analysis.csv:9 — 1079622 ex-RUSTEC vs mellren + 13 other CS2 teams (6666, Banda chuya, Zomblers, BIG Academy, Honved, Johnny Speeds, Just Players, Leo, Lilmix, Misa, METANOIA Wolves, Mai Tai, UNO MILLE)
explanation: Valve's standings_global_2026_10_05.md contains 31 duplicate team names (active 5-man roster higher up, older/partial roster lower down). slate/collect.py iterates top-to-bottom and overwrites vrs[key]=row, replacing ex-RUSTEC #92 (1066 pts, #L97) with #152 (824 pts, #L157), 6666 #127 (923 pts) with #368 (425 pts), and Banda Chuya #165 (801 pts) with #373 (402 pts). codes: Started CS2 Fixture Misclassified as sport='other'
subject: slate/collect.py & slate/data/fixtures.csv:66 — 1081076 ex-Keyd Stars vs Galorys (ESL Challenger League Season 52 SA Cup #3)
explanation: slate/collect.py's sport_of(fixture) classifies sport solely by which page (cs2-pickems vs lobby) rendered the card and ignores sport_alias='cs2' in the TransferState payload. Once 1081076 kicked off at 2026-10-13T21:00:00Z, /cs2-pickems dropped it while /lobby retained it with sport_alias='cs2', causing slate/data/fixtures.csv to misclassify 1081076 as sport='other' and omit it from CS2 analysis. | Resolution: Classified by sport_alias='cs2' and verified official final score (ex-Keyd Stars 0 - 2 Galorys) on HLTV match 2399204.

codes: HTML Block Truncation Dropping 37 HLTV Ranks & False FL-03 Flags
subject: live/collect.py:614 & live/data/slate.csv — 9z (#17), MIBR (#12), Ninjas in Pyjamas (#26), HOTU (#41), Voca (#59), BC.Game (#70), ex-RUSTEC (#79), Phantom (#88), WBT/WROTBERRY (#109), ROUNDS/RoundsGG (#237)
explanation: live/collect.py truncates each .ranked-team HTML block at block[:4000] before searching for /team/<id>/<slug>. For 37 of the 245 ranked teams on HLTV (including open-slate teams MIBR #12, 9z #17, NiP #26, HOTU #41, Voca #59, Phantom #88), the team profile link sits past byte 4000, leaving hltv_rank blank in live/data/slate.csv and triggering false FL-03 ('missing from HLTV top-30') flags on 9z (#17) and MIBR (#12). Also, slug.replace('-', ' ') turns ex-rustec into 'ex rustec' and bcgame into 'bcgame', failing exact match for ex-RUSTEC (#79) and BC.Game (#70). | Resolution: Parsed the full 245-team HLTV ranking snapshot without 4,000-byte truncation and verified team IDs directly against HLTV match pages.

codes: Series Format Assumed BO3 on 12 Official BO1 Matches

Both HLTV (matches 2399418..2399429) and EGamersWorld explicitly list all 12 group-stage matches as Best-of-1 (BO1). | Resolution: Verified series_format='BO1' for 1080279..1080290 directly from HLTV match pages 2399418..2399429 and EGW.
